name: The High Power Laser Laboratory
supervisors: China Academy of Engineering Physics (per the Canadian and US lists)

evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list and the US Entity List both name the High Power Laser Laboratory among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP), which the US Commerce Department describes as the technology complex responsible for the research, development and testing of China’s nuclear weapons; unlike CAEP’s Mianyang institutes, the Entity List places it in Shanghai.
